programs.title: NEW BRANCH — Space-Time Cluster Detection command tour
programs.description: Runs the bounded case-only space-time permutation candidate with a planted five-day cluster, deterministic seed, Worker progress, cancellation, aggregate-only Output, and an inline result map.
programs.source:
EPIAI CLUSTER SPACE_TIME ID=case_id DATE=event_date LATITUDE=latitude LONGITUDE=longitude RESULT=FeverRashClusters START=2026-01-01 END=2026-01-28 UNIT=DAY LENGTH=1 MAXDISTANCEKM=5 MAXCASEFRACTION=0.5 MAXTIMEUNITS=7 MAXTIMEFRACTION=0.5 REPLICATIONS=999 SEED=20260916

EPIAI CLUSTER RENDER RESULT=FeverRashClusters
